```{r scratch-viz-setup, include=FALSE}
# Publication figure system: house theme, validated colour-vision-safe palette,
# and vector (PDF) output alongside every raster figure. Applied globally, so
# the plotting code below needs no changes. Guarded: if the library is not
# staged, the notebook renders exactly as it did before.
local({
  roots <- c(".", "assets/viz", Sys.getenv("SCRATCH_VIZ_DIR", "."))
  for (lib in c("scratch_viz.R", "scratch_report.R")) {
    for (r in roots) {
      p <- file.path(r, lib)
      if (file.exists(p)) { source(p, local = FALSE); break }
    }
  }
})
```

```{r setup, include = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, echo = FALSE}

# Project parameters 
project_name <- params$project_name
project_object <- params$project_object

# Inputs and thresholds
input_model <- params$input_model

```


```{r setup}
library(copykat)
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(cowplot)

```

## Folder structure

```{r project_directory}

if(!dir.exists(work_directory)) {
  dir.create(work_directory, recursive = T)
}

for(sub_directory in c('data', 'figures')) {
  dir.create(paste0(work_directory, '/', sub_directory))
}

```


```{r loading_rds}

# Reading seurat object
seurat_object <- readRDS(file = seurat_object)

# Extract normalized expression matrix
expr_mat <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(seurat_obj, slot = "data"))
```

```{r running copykat}
copykat_result <- copykat(rawmat = expr_mat,
                          id.type = "S",         # Ensembl gene symbols
                          ngene.chr = 5,
                          win.size = 25,
                          distance = "euclidean",
                          norm.cell.names = NULL,
                          n.cores = 4)

write.csv(copykat_result$prediction, "copykat_prediction.csv")
saveRDS(copykat_result, "copykat_result.rds")
```

```{r Annotate Seurat Object}
seurat_obj$copykat_prediction <- copykat_result$prediction[colnames(seurat_obj), "copykat.pred"]
saveRDS(seurat_obj, "seurat_copykat_annotated.rds")
```

```{r UMAP}
p_umap <- DimPlot(seurat_obj, group.by = "copykat_prediction", pt.size = 0.4) +
  ggtitle("CopyKAT CNV Prediction") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
p_umap
ggsave("umap_copykat.png", plot = p_umap, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```


```{r CNV Class Barplot}
cnv_counts <- seurat_obj@meta.data %>%
  count(copykat_prediction)

p_bar <- ggplot(cnv_counts, aes(x = copykat_prediction, y = n, fill = copykat_prediction)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(title = "CNV Class Distribution", x = "CNV Class", y = "Cell Count") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
p_bar
ggsave("barplot_copykat.png", plot = p_bar, width = 5, height = 4, dpi = 300)

```
